mil7.8.1:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, kumbhassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti yaṃ vadesi, kataman-taṃ ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabban-ti. -
mil7.8.1:1.2: Yathā mahārāja kumbho sampuṇṇo na saṇati,
mil7.8.1:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena āgame adhigame pariyattiyaṃ sāmaññe pāramiṃ patvā na saṇitabbaṃ, na tena māno karaṇīyo, na dappo dassetabbo, nihatamānena nihatadappena bhavitabbaṃ ujukena amukharena avikatthinā.
mil7.8.1:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja kumbhassa ekaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.8.1:1.5: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā devātidevena Suttanipāte:
